items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember what kind of cymbals he used at all, Louis Petron? [INTERVIEWEE] Zildjian.

ctx.x: Most likely, I wouldn't say all of them, but every time I seen him, he used it. Now, what did he ever use when he was working at Tranchina's nightclub, that old Spanish food? I don't know what kind of drums he's using out there, you know.
Do you remember what kind of cymbals he used at all, Louis Petron?
